x-http.notes: There is no generic `PUT /documents/{id}/status` endpoint (confirmed against the real Postman collection and live sandbox testing). Real mechanisms, verified live 2026-07-08: "paid" -> issue a linked Receipt (type 400, linkedDocumentIds=[invoice_id]) via POST /documents; Morning then flips the original's status automatically. "unpaid" -> idempotent no-op if not yet paid; otherwise rejected (POST /documents/{id}/open returns 400 errorCode 2401 "לא ניתן לפתוח מסמך שאינו סגור ידנית" for documents closed via a linked receipt rather than /close itself — no supported reversal). "cancelled" -> issue a linked Credit Invoice (type 330, linkedDocumentIds=[invoice_id]) via POST /documents; Israeli law forbids voiding an issued tax invoice outright. POST /documents/{id}/close and /open exist and work for other document lifecycles (e.g. orders/proformas) but return 400 errorCode 3000 for tax invoices (type 305) — not used by this tool.
